name: free-code-deepseek-harness
description: Multiplatform desktop GUI shell for deepseek-harness powered by an opencode2api worker pool (DeepSeek-free first, zero-config)

scripts.test: pnpm prepare:upstream && pnpm --filter @freecode/opencode-adapter build && pnpm -r --filter "./packages/**" --filter "./apps/**" test
scripts.test:contract: pnpm prepare:upstream && pnpm --filter @freecode/opencode-adapter build && pnpm --filter @freecode/contract-tests test
scripts.build:desktop: pnpm build && pnpm package:runtime && pnpm --filter @freecode/shell package
